ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across the central and outer lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is localized along the entire trailing edge with a jagged interface. A vertical low-intensity pillar is centered at the median notch. Discrete dark focal spots are sparsely distributed across the white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 48 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 2 to 10 pixels in amplitude relative to the local edge vector.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve tapering toward the tips. The trailing edges follow a complex sigmoidal curve from the median notch to the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, textured pixel clusters representing barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes. Multiple small, raised circular white spots are detected across the flat fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel tracks (rake marks) are visible on the distal third of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at both fluke tips; dark linear rake marks on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular mottled transition zone between the black trailing edge pigmentation and the white central lobe area.
